name: jev-guardrails
description: Screens every prompt going into the conversation and every reply coming out of it with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model, the way TypeSafe's guardrails cookbook does: one request per message asks a battery of hazard questions (jailbreak, harm or a crime, a diagnosis or a dosage, self-harm) and scores how much harm complying would do. The thresholds live here, in a named policy (strict or permissive), and turn the probabilities into pass, review (the user is asked), block (the prompt is dropped, or the reply withheld) or support. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway, since only it reports a calibrated probability per answer

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with none set the engine's built-in classifier is used instead

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: Which backend to use; "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: The cookbook's named thresholds: strict acts at 0.70, permissive at 0.85; both review from 0.35 and let a severity of 2.0 turn a review into a block

reviewThreshold.title: Review threshold
reviewThreshold.description: Overrides the policy's review line when set: a hazard probability at or above this sends the message to review. Leave unset to use the policy's own (0.35 in both)

actionThreshold.title: Action threshold
actionThreshold.description: Overrides the policy's action line when set: a hazard probability at or above this triggers the hazard's action (block, review or support). Leave unset to use the policy's own (strict 0.70, permissive 0.85)

severityBlock.title: Severity block
severityBlock.description: Overrides the policy's severity line when set: a severity score (0-3) at or above this turns a review into a block. Leave unset to use the policy's own (2.0 in both)

screenInput.title: Screen prompts
screenInput.description: Run the input battery on every prompt the user submits

screenOutput.title: Screen replies
screenOutput.description: "block" holds each reply's text until it is screened and withholds one that fails; "audit" streams replies live and only logs the screening; "off" leaves replies alone

screenSubagents.title: Screen subagent replies
screenSubagents.description: Also run the output battery on each subagent's responses; off screens the main conversation alone

disabledHazards.title: Disabled hazards
disabledHazards.description: Comma-separated hazards left out of both batteries (jailbreak, broke_policy, harmful_request, medical_advice, self_harm)

failClosed.title: Fail closed on input
failClosed.description: Drop a prompt the backend could not screen (timeout, error); off lets it through and says so. Replies are never dropped for this

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a screening before letting the message through unchanged

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each screening and its outcome to the session log
